rationale: The description specifies conventional service-order automation and a direct interface for updating NPAC fields during number porting.
evidence_spans: Neustar Service Order Administration (SOA) automates the process of updating the Number Portability Administration Center (NPAC) during the number porting process. Neustar provides a direct interface with the NPAC, enabling the full use of all NPAC fields and features for IP, TDM and wireless services.
